principle: customer-facing surfaces use the current user-approved formal DM / formal visual first; products-v3 remains the immutable real-product identity reference only; guards validate the current authority and must not force old simple originals back to customer surfaces
product_image_authority: products-v3 true original product photos remain the immutable identity authority for package shape, label, material and proportion; they are internal/reference authority and are not the required customer-facing main visual

post_image_policy: trial copy always uses the 20260812 approved trial master; guilu-drink product copy prefers the current formal DM / trial-master-derived visual; other product copy uses each product's own formal DM; lifestyle content uses the current user post catalog after semantic matching by season, scene, environment, temperature, expression, action and props; products-v3 is the real-product identity reference only; only a true no-match may request regeneration; any generated, replaced or edited content invalidates prior approval, returns to pending_review and must pass the 16-item review gate
guard_policy: validate the current designated formal visual and the real product identity separately; do not reject a correct customer-facing formal DM merely because it is not a products-v3 simple original; do not force old versions, old filenames, old fixed copy or retired visual layers back into production
